scope: The 80 numbered theorem, proposition, lemma, corollary, definition, and remark environments in the complete reconstruction, compared with the frozen NavierStokes Lean sources.

manuscript.line_locator_semantics: one-based line on which the numbered environment begins; for lem:5.1 the label itself follows on line 458

what_was_checked: frozen Git commit and tree identity
archive SHA-256 against the source-freeze receipt
manuscript statement labels and one-based source lines
Lean declaration headers, one-based source lines, surrounding statements, namespaces, and selected import edges
verification_status.warning: This is a static source concordance, not a Lean build certificate. formalization.yaml's sorry counts, proved statuses, and axiom lists are reported metadata, not independently reproduced here.

coverage_categories.official_alignment: formalization.yaml explicitly aligns the manuscript statement with the named public Lean declaration. Static inspection confirms the declaration and adapter chain exist; this audit did not build them.
coverage_categories.strong_static_correspondence: One declaration or a small explicit package has a statement that substantially mirrors the manuscript result. The repository metadata does not explicitly align the manuscript number, so this is a source-reading judgment, not an official alignment or build claim.
coverage_categories.partial_static_correspondence: Named declarations formalize identifiable formulas, clauses, or construction components, but not the full numbered manuscript statement as one proved declaration.
coverage_categories.indirect_pipeline_only: Relevant modules or downstream packages use the subject matter, but no declaration-level static match for the complete numbered statement was identified.
coverage_categories.not_identified: No defensible declaration-level or pipeline correspondence was identified in this bounded static audit.

official_alignment_evidence.qualification: The metadata says full formalization of main results and self-assessed review. Its sorry and axiom fields were not independently reproduced in this no-build audit.

statements.label: thm:1.1
statements.assessment: formalization.yaml explicitly aligns Theorem 1.1 to D001; D003 and D005-D007 expose the inspected adapter and paper-theorem packages.

statements.label: thm:3.1
statements.assessment: D009's fields mirror the theorem's principal clauses and D010 closes the existential package; the heat-exterior consequences are separately exposed.

statements.label: def:3.2
statements.assessment: The actual slow-axis construction proves smoothness and axis jets, but no declaration defining the manuscript phrase 'regular at the axis' verbatim was identified.

statements.label: def:3.3
statements.assessment: This is a prose convention for parameter order and uniform smallness; no single Lean definition matching it was identified.

statements.label: lem:4.1
statements.assessment: The time and axial chain coefficients are formalized; this pair does not by itself certify every displayed chain-rule identity in Lemma 4.1.

statements.label: prop:4.2
statements.assessment: The two leading-stress divergence components are explicit; the entire proposition, including every physical residual clause, is not mapped to one declaration.

statements.label: lem:4.3
statements.assessment: The angular and axial integrated identities are stated separately in Lean and together cover the lemma's two principal formulas.

statements.label: lem:4.4
statements.assessment: Lean has the exact moment-propagation component and a comparison norm, but no single declaration matching all hypotheses and conclusions of the manuscript lemma was identified.

statements.label: lem:4.5
statements.assessment: The algebraic and paper-facing admissible-cone equivalences closely match the stated criterion.

statements.label: thm:4.6
statements.assessment: The conclusion is distributed across a final profile record, final-base existence, weighted true-cone bounds, and nominal-cone certificates; this is not an official theorem-number alignment.

statements.label: lem:4.7
statements.assessment: The determinant, smooth inverse, and compact-family derivative bounds cover the moment-matrix content.

statements.label: lem:4.8
statements.assessment: A prepared outgoing profile is constructed downstream, but no declaration with the lemma's full ordered parameter choices, exterior formulae, moments, and heat behavior was identified.

statements.label: lem:4.9
statements.assessment: The final construction proves right-edge stress vanishing, but the displayed tail integral representation and limiting direction are not matched as one declaration.

statements.label: prop:4.10
statements.assessment: The axis-to-outer construction is split among entrance, exit, continuation, and exact matching packages; no single declaration matching all of Proposition 4.10 was identified.

statements.label: lem:4.11
statements.assessment: The local periodic cone family, uniform margin, boundary matching, and uniform collar appear explicitly in these declarations.

statements.label: lem:5.1
statements.assessment: Lean constructs an all-order local slow hierarchy; the manuscript's uniqueness and every displayed profile equation are not exposed as one theorem here.

statements.label: lem:5.2
statements.assessment: The declaration's source comment identifies the actual reference-path extension and bounds corresponding to Lemma 5.2.

statements.label: prop:5.3
statements.assessment: The local hierarchy and global reference bounds feed the finite sums, but no exact declaration for the proposition's divergence and residual estimate package was identified.

statements.label: lem:5.4
statements.assessment: The Borel-type summation is packaged as existence of smooth base fields; this remains a static semantic match rather than metadata alignment.

statements.label: prop:5.5
statements.assessment: The constructed and final slow-base packages collect the divergence, residual-stress, support, and profile conclusions.

statements.label: lem:6.2

statements.label: lem:6.3

statements.label: def:6.4

statements.label: def:6.5

statements.label: prop:6.6

statements.label: lem:B.7

statements.label: prop:B.8
